description: Spec 104 T026 refusal-rate probe: run the FR-008 severance transplant (engine severTouchKey) over every K_-linked touch key of every corpus keyboard that has a touch layout, and report the refusal rate + binding causes per keyboard. Evidence for sizing the Track 2 (Adapt) choice UX — NOT a CI gate: refusals are findings, so a completed scan exits 0; scanning nothing exits 2 (a probe that examined no keyboards must never look like a pass).
name: refusal-probe
